title: ICAI Declares CA Foundation September 2026 Exam Results
content:
# ICAI Declares CA Foundation September 2026 Exam Results

Ek important update hai! The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne CA Foundation September 2026 examination ke results announce kar diye hain. Candidates jo is exam mein appear hue the, ab apna result check kar sakte hain.

*   **Result Declaration Date:** The CA Foundation September 2026 exam results were declared on November 6, 2026.
*   **How to Check:** Aspirants can check their scorecards by visiting the official results portal. You'll need your registration number and roll number to log in and view your marks.
*   **Pass Percentage:** This session saw an overall pass percentage of 18.93%.
*   **Toppers:** Kansika and Mahek Gupta shared the All India Rank (AIR) 1 in the September 2026 session, securing 361 marks.

Qualifying students are now eligible to register for the CA Intermediate examination.

## Read the Official Document
*   [Check your CA Foundation September 2026 Results here](https://caresults.icai.org)

*Published on: 7 November 2026*
